name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Kael, 32 gp, and 62 gp go with Elf, Gnome, and Tiefling, in some order.
If both Mara does not go with 32 gp and Orin goes with Gnome, then both 62 gp goes with Tiefling and Dwarf goes with Mara.
32 gp, 42 gp, and 62 gp go with Mara, Gnome, and Tiefling, in some order.
Either Orin goes with Elf or Mara goes with Dwarf.
If Tiefling goes with Orin, then 32 gp goes with Mara.

hints.text: Suppose Kael went with Dwarf — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Kael goes with Dwarf.
Kael goes with Dwarf, so it can't also go with Elf.
Kael goes with Dwarf, so it can't also go with Gnome.
Kael goes with Dwarf, so it can't also go with Tiefling.
…but now the clue “Kael, 32 gp, and 62 gp go with Elf, Gnome, and Tiefling, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Kael does not go with Dwarf.
